name: The Chiba Kogyo Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Chiba Kogyo Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Japan. The company offers deposit and lending, securities investment, and domestic and foreign exchange services, as well as trades in commodity securities. It also provides entrusted services for corporate bonds; card, car, renovation, home, mortgage, education, private practitioner, medical, agri-lawn, and business loans; IT and payment services; and business and management support services. The company was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.
